about: Which MCP client made a call, from the name it gave itself in the handshake or in the request. The only place this is decided: the API classifies every call with these rules, the dashboard names the types with these labels, and the SDKs send the name alone. The name is lower-cased and trimmed, then the rules are tried in order and the first that matches wins. Edit this file to recognise a new client; the API reclassifies stored calls when it starts with rules that changed.

rules.note: Claude Desktop, chat included, as local-agent-mode-<server name>. First, because the server's name follows and could be anything. Seen 2026-10-15.
